title: I'm a psychologist who studies couples—5 signs you've fallen into a common rut: 'It builds through small habits that each look harmless'
summary_full: Couples today are vulnerable to "coexistence without contact," says psychologist Mark Travers. Here are the symptoms — and what you can do to counteract them.
